worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.summary: Launch steel bombs that magnetic pull drags onto the target; a bomb sticks the moment it touches and detonates when its fuse runs out, so it cannot be shaken. Cluster piles every bomb onto one target; Spread divides them among a ring of enemies.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.use.0: Stick steel bombs to a target then detonate them
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.use.1: Seed a ring of enemies with bombs at once
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.use.2: Force a target to react before the fuse ends
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.description: All bombs together deal about %1$s power, split into %2$s bombs stuck to the target; defence, type matchup and crit are settled on the hit.
A bomb detonates %1$s s after it sticks, with a %2$s block blast radius each.
Magnetic pull turns %1$s degrees per tick, locking targets within %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks/tick.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.cluster.on: Cluster: every bomb piles onto the chosen target for heavier single damage; windup is 2 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.cluster.off: Spread: bombs divide among every enemy in range for wider coverage, but one target only eats its share.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s then costs %4$s PP, recover %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.growth.0: At level %1$s: total power %2$s and %3$s bombs.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.growth.1: At level %1$s: total power %2$s and fuse %3$s s.
On (Cluster): every bomb piles onto the chosen target for heavier single damage, but windup is 2 ticks longer and coverage is small. Off (Spread): bombs divide among every enemy in range for wider coverage, but one target only eats its share.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of firing. Larger values open from further.
On: a high-health enemy is preferred, since the fuse pays off; off: order it like a plain ranged attack.
